$description: Closed asset-role vocabulary. Wired through schema/pagespec.schema.json (definitions.assetRole enum), tokens/llm/component-allowlist.json (assetRoles) and the example instances. Built from real usage sites only.
realCompanyNotice: Refire is a real company and this repo documents an authorized rebuild of its live site. Its logo, product photography, hero film, brochure and proprietary copy belong to Refire. A generator may reuse the STRUCTURE (sections, tokens, motion) but must never fabricate or reproduce those assets or that copy for any new page: generated PageSpecs use neutral 'placeholder:<role>' sources and original copy. semantic_validate.py enforces this for every provenance:'generated' instance.

generationPolicies.placeholder-only: A generated PageSpec must use src/href 'placeholder:<role>'. Reproducing, tracing, re-encoding or AI-fabricating a look-alike of the real asset is forbidden. Only provenance:'reference' instances (the documented reproduction of the authorized clone) may point at allowedReferenceSources.
generationPolicies.must-reuse-exact: Use exactly the declared asset through its token; never substitute or redistribute.
generationPolicies.may-reuse-exact: Reuse exactly as the section contract fixes it; inventing new variants is out of contract.

brand.logo.guidance: Refire's wordmark. Never reproduce it, trace it, or fabricate a look-alike on a generated page. Use src 'placeholder:brand.logo' and let a human supply the real brand mark of whoever owns the generated page.

brand.favicon.guidance: Document-level brand icons. Not a PageSpec slot; generated pages must not ship Refire's favicons.

media.hero-video.guidance: Refire's own product film. Never reproduce, re-encode, excerpt or synthesize an imitation. Generated pages use 'placeholder:media.hero-video'.

media.hero-poster.guidance: Still frame of the hero film. Same restrictions as media.hero-video.

media.scroll-picture.guidance: Refire PRISMA product photography. Never reproduce or AI-generate an imitation of Refire products. Generated pages use 'placeholder:media.scroll-picture' (a neutral 16:9 placeholder of at least 3840x2160 behaves identically).

media.shader-picture.guidance: Refire product photography used as the WebGL texture. Same restrictions as media.scroll-picture; the texture must be same-origin.

media.social-image.guidance: og:image / twitter:image. Not a PageSpec slot; generated pages must not reuse Refire photography for social previews.

document.brochure.guidance: Refire's PDF brochure (the only document link on the site). Generated pages must link 'placeholder:document.brochure', never the real PDF and never an external URL.

font.brand-typeface.guidance: SuisseIntl is a commercially licensed typeface. Reference it only through font.family.brand inside the authorized Refire rebuild; never redistribute the font files or substitute a look-alike and call it SuisseIntl. Outside the authorized rebuild, fall back to the declared stack (Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif).

ui.icon.guidance: Generic geometric UI glyphs (arrows, chevrons, circles). They are fixed by the section contracts, not chosen per page; reuse exactly, never invent new glyphs.
